title: Robust ML Auditing using Prior Knowledge

layout.note: Three stacked time bands (before, during, after the audit) separated by dotted grey lines; the Platform box sits at the left and Users or Auditor at the right in the top two bands, with a pair of arrows between each; three callouts hang on the steps.

lesson: Cut an actor diagram into named time bands with dotted dividers, redraw the same actor in each band with its model state colour-coded, and hang numbered callouts on the actor or link that performs each step.
